scopeClarification: The user-requested hand-authored sfx-audio-to-text provider (2026-09-26; docs/audio-to-text.md) is outside this eleven-altitude admitted surface and is not declared in the estate. This policy's baseline and shrink-only rule continue to apply to the listed altitude providers.

baseline.note: Immutable admission ceiling: the eleven authoring-altitude code providers (the local HTTPS services in providers/) whose declared bridge placement is the authoring-altitude-model-stubs surface. Later behavior does not move this ceiling; the surface may only shrink toward deletion.
